title: Document / ReferenceArchitecture node
description: One row per markdown file (type=Document) or per RA folder (type=ReferenceArchitecture, one aggregate row per RA0xxx grouping its Documents). Derived deterministically from front matter and folder structure - always evidence_type=explicit.

node_id.description: 'doc:<front-matter id>' for Document nodes, 'ra:<RA folder, e.g. RA0029>' for ReferenceArchitecture nodes.

front_matter_id.description: The `id` field from front matter (Document nodes only).

source_section.description: null here always means 'front matter / folder membership, not body text' (the only evidence_type used for Document/ReferenceArchitecture rows). Not applicable to the '__introduction__' convention, which is for body-text evidence only (see entity.schema.json / relationship.schema.json).
